item.title: IMD forecasts Snow, Rain across Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Dec 31: A weak Western Disturbance is affecting Jammu and Kashmir, bringing light rain and snowfall to parts of north Kashmir, officials said. The upper reaches, including Gulmarg, Sadhna Top, and Tulail Valley, received light to moderate snowfall, while most other areas remained generally cloudy, an official said.
